purpose: Development full-trace storage planning, not measured artifact volume or a speed result
caveats: These estimates use the fixed successful clean output class; they are not exact sampler-call counts or a guaranteed bound.
Native/startup logs, route text, source proofs, unused final rows and any replay add overhead.
Full trace writes already-available CPU logits; it does not request a new backend readback.
Recheck available space before launch. Preserve the failed r1 and all new raw observations; do not delete or rewrite them for a passing result.
retention: Retain raw sampler files and run data on inference-host, copy and SHA256-verify locally; use lossless compression for large committed text metadata/logs, not raw model or inference source files.
